restoration_note: The teaching tracks the self's self-assertion (clamor and war), its joining and being drawn up into a structured world (the natural mind permitted to form), the Lord's principles dwelling within so that refining can begin, the Erring's own bringing-forth of disordered forms, the molding of Adam from the lowest depth, and the first opening of sight after eating from the planted perception. Most gaps were tightly constrained by editor proposals completing visible word-stems (ⲙ̄ⲙ̄ϣⲉ, ⲡⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ, ⲙⲛ̄ⲛ̄ⲥⲱⲥ, ⲡⲙⲩⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲛ̄ⲧⲟ̄ⲙⲡⲗⲁⲥⲥⲉ, ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ, ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧϥ̄). Two larger lacunae ({2}, {4}) were filled by spiritual context: the "great clamor" (ⲥⲁⲩϣ) directly named in the reading, and ⲧⲏⲣϥ̄ as a natural totalizer for the cosmos. Gap {7} (8 chars, partial ⲁ) was filled with ⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ as the self's bringings-forth — moderate confidence given multiple plausible candidates.

coptic_restorations.basis: Editor restoration completing ⲙ̄ⲙ̄ϣⲉ ('of fighting'). The visible -ϣⲉ trace and the parallel with ⲡⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ in the same line confirm the Coptic doublet 'fighting and war'.
Editor restoration completing the Greek loanword ⲡⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ ('the war'). Standard Manichaean term for the cosmic conflict; the visible ⲡⲟⲗ- trace fixes the reading.

Est. 4 chars. The reading explicitly names 'a great clamor' from which the war is set loose; ⲡⲛⲁⲟ̄ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁⲩϣ ('the great clamor/cry') fits the syntax (great-N-noun) and stands in apposition to ⲡⲙ̄ⲗⲁⲍ ('the strife/battle').
Editor restoration: ⲙⲛ̄ⲛ̄ⲥⲱⲥ ('afterward, after that'), the standard Lycopolitan transitional phrase. Fits the visible ⲙⲛ- trace and the narrative pivot in the reading.

Est. 4 chars. After ⲡⲓ̈ⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ('this world'), the natural totalizer ⲧⲏⲣϥ̄ ('whole/entire') fits the count and matches the reading: the self's joined states are 'drawn up into this whole world' as a structured natural mind.

Editor restoration: ⲛ̄ⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉ ('the gods/divine ones of the Light'). The visible -ⲧⲉ trace confirms ⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉ; in the reading these are 'the Lord's principles already dwelling' within the formed vessel so refining may begin.

Editor restoration completing ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ('the Light forth'). The visible ⲡⲟⲩ- trace and the verb ⲁⲥⲱⲧϥ̄ ('to refine') govern this object; refining-forth is the corpus's standard description of what the Lord's interior presence accomplishes within the permitted vessel.

Est. 8 chars, partial ⲁ. ⲡⲥⲁⲣⲙⲉ ('the Erring') with its ⲧⲁⲡⲟ ('bringing-forth') wants an object. The reading speaks of the Erring 'multiplying perceptions in the wandering' — the self's particular forms. ⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ ('of the archons', the lexicon's 'particular forms the self takes') matches the character count and contains the partial ⲁ. Manichaean parallels link Saklas/Error with the begetting of archons just before Adam's molding.
Editor restoration: ⲡⲙⲩⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲛ̄ⲧ-ⲟ̄ⲙⲡⲗⲁⲥⲥⲉ ('the mystery of the molding'). Visible -ⲙⲡⲗⲁⲥⲥⲉ confirms the Greek πλάσσειν stem; parallels the chapter's other 'mystery of...' formula in section 1.

Editor restoration completing ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ ('the First Man'). Visible ⲡϣⲁⲣ- and the lexicon's stable corpus title fix this. Note: here applied to Adam as the molded archetype of the natural mind, the title's lower mirror.
Editor restoration: 3rd masc. sg. suffix pronoun completing ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧϥ̄ ('from it'), referring back to the perception/tree of the previous clause. Grammar fully constrains.

english_segments.core_english: and the Darkness — the mystery of the strife: fighting and the war,
and the great {0} the battle that the Darkness unleashed forth. Afterward,
the Darkness — through their joining, they were drawn up into this {1} world,
the gods of the Light dwell in them, to refine the Light forth
from the creation. The Erring itself, with the bringing-forth {2},
Deep, {3} molding of Adam, the first man,
from which Adam ate, and his eyes saw forth.

english_restorations.basis: Renders ⲥⲁⲩϣ as 'clamor', the very word the spiritual reading uses ('asserts itself with a great clamor'); the appositive Coptic ⲡⲙ̄ⲗⲁⲍ supplies 'battle'.
Renders the totalizer ⲧⲏⲣϥ̄ naturally with the preceding ⲡⲓ̈ⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ — 'this whole world' — matching the reading's image of the natural mind taking shape as a structured field.
Renders ⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ using the lexicon's standard English ('archons' = particular forms the self takes); supplies the object of ⲧⲁⲡⲟ ('bringing-forth') as the Erring's manifold disordered productions.
Renders ⲡⲙⲩⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲛ̄ⲧⲟ̄(ⲙⲡⲗⲁⲥⲥⲉ); the trailing 'molding of Adam' belongs to the visible Coptic. Mirrors section 1's parallel formula 'the mystery of the strife'.
